# Hordi Nails

> Home nail studio in Upplands Väsby, north of Stockholm, Sweden. Run by Diana (@hordi_nails). Gel-X extensions, upper forms, gel polish and detailed nail art: chrome, lace French, charms, 3D gel, hand painting. One client at a time. No prepayment. Prices and booking online at https://hordinails.com/.

## Booking
- Book online: https://hordinails.com/#booking (choose length, design tier, extras and gel colours, see price and time, pick a slot).
- No prepayment, pay at the studio.
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hordi_nails/

## Location and hours
- Home studio in Upplands Väsby, Stockholms län, Sweden. Exact address is sent with the booking confirmation.
- Monday–Friday 10:00–19:00, Saturday 12:00–18:00 (earlier sometimes possible on request), Sunday closed.

## Prices (SEK, removal, prep and one gel colour included)
- Gel polish on natural nail (XS): 200
- Gel-X, S (up to 0.5 cm past fingertip): 300
- Gel-X, M (about 1 cm): 400
- Gel-X, L (about 1.5 cm): 550
- Gel-X, XL (about 2 cm): 650
- Gel-X, XXL (2.5 cm or more): 900
- Upper forms instead of Gel-X: +100, about +40 min
- Design for the whole set: tier 1 +50 (French, chrome, simple lines), tier 2 +100 (abstract, small charms), tier 3 +150 (hand-painted details, 3D gel), tier 4 +200 (complex charms, sculpted elements), tier 5 +500 (realistic or portrait-style painting)
- Strengthening: +50. Removal of someone else's work: +50.

## Time
- About 2.5 hours for gel polish on natural nails with removal and strengthening.
- Detailed tier 5 sets take about 5–6 hours.

## Good to know
- 75 gel polish colours to choose from.
- Please come alone (no waiting area). Send your design at least 2 days before.
- Late 20–30 min with notice: +100 SEK; more than 30 min late: cancelled.
- Swedish: nagelstudio i Upplands Väsby, Gel-X, nagelförlängning, gellack, nageldesign, från 200 kr.
